text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
L-Lord Orfevre?
What is the matter, staring into the mirror like that...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: (...This physique... Do I sense any slack...?)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
Then I have only to correct it.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre!
Here are your after-dinner sweets!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no need.
Refrain from offerings for a while. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And as for tonight's dinner, it has an excess of fats and carbohydrates.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I will not permit any meals lacking nutritional balance.
...Carve that into your memory.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer C
text_block_list.text:
A-As you command...!
Your wish is my decree...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I am heading to the gym. I need no company, understand?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
"...W-What does this mean...?
Don't tell me—"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Did we incur the king's wrath?!
Otherwise, she wouldn't be this furious!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer C
text_block_list.text:
N-No, but I have no memory of such a thing...
What has enraged the King so...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, Orfevre successfully completed her diet
without her subjects ever realizing
she had been trying to lose weight."
